title: Filler: Ren Makes Dinner
later: Dinner's on me... later. Finish what you're doing first, and don't let sensei catch you slacking!

offer.speaker: ren
offer.text: So, uh... Last one up the cliff makes dinner. That's me. The thing is, I can't cook.

offer.speaker: ren
offer.text: Sensei says Ichiraku counts, as long as I'm paying. Come on, before I change my mind!

steps.text: Have dinner with Team Six at Ichiraku Ramen

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: Order whatever you want! ...Within reason. Within, like, a small bowl of reason.

dialogue.speaker: teuchi
dialogue.text: Four bowls? Ha! The big spender of Team Six!

dialogue.speaker: yui
dialogue.text: Ren, you've counted your coins three times.

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: A team that eats together trusts each other with their backs. That's the real lesson tonight.

dialogue.speaker: tatsumi
dialogue.text: ...And I'll pay. Ren, put your wallet away before you cry into the broth.

lines.speaker: tatsumi
lines.text: Thank me by not falling off the cliff tomorrow.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: I owe you one! ...A small one!
